youtube.baslik: Why does sound get louder when you block your ear canal? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Place a tuning fork on the mastoid and block the ear canal, and the sound suddenly gets louder; this is the occlusion effect. With supra-aural earphones the increase at 250 Hz can average up to about 30 dB, because low-frequency energy radiated into the canal cannot escape.

instagram.kanca: Why does sound get louder when you block your ear canal?
bilgiler: Blocking the ear canal boosts low sounds arriving by bone conduction.
With supra-aural earphones, the rise at 250 Hz can reach about 30 dB.
Why: low-frequency energy in the canal cannot escape.

cumleler: Why does sound get louder when you block your ear canal?
